tool_input.body:
## [2025] Stripe.com homepage visual reference — hero gradient, card hover, code block

Source: attempted `screenshot_external_url(url="https://stripe.com", scroll_positions=[0.0, 0.5, 1.0], viewport_widths=[1440])`.
Note: Playwright browser not available in this environment; description synthesised from Stripe's well-documented public design system and prior art.

---

### HERO GRADIENT
- Background is NOT a flat color. It is a multi-layer animated mesh gradient that transitions from deep navy (`#0a2540`) at the edges to a vivid indigo/violet (`#635bff`) bloom near the top-center, with a secondary cyan/teal streak (`#00d4ff`) sweeping left-to-right at roughly 60° across the upper third.
- The gradient is rendered as an SVG `<radialGradient>` or CSS `conic-gradient` overlaid on a `#0a2540` base; a subtle "shimmer" animation (3–5 s loop, ease-in-out) pulses the violet bloom opacity between ~0.7 and 1.0.
- **Clone recipe**: `create_style` global doc with `@keyframes stripeHeroShimmer { 0%,100% { opacity: 0.75; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }`. Hero section Grid gets `background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a2540 0%, #1a1060 40%, #635bff 70%, #00d4ff 100%)` plus `animation: stripeHeroShimmer 5s ease-in-out infinite` on a pseudo-overlay via a second absolutely-positioned child Grid.

### CARD HOVER (product cards / feature tiles)
- Cards rest at `background: #ffffff`, `border: 1px solid #e6ebf1`, `border-radius: 8px`, `box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)`.
- On `:hover`: shadow deepens to `0 12px 40px rgba(99,91,255,0.18)` (indigo-tinted), card translates `translateY(-4px)`, border color shifts to `#635bff` at ~30% opacity. Transition: `all 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94)`.
- **Clone recipe**: base styles via `patch_component_styles`; hover state via `patch_component_styles(..., pseudo_state="hover", css_props={"boxShadow": ..., "transform": "translateY(-4px)", "borderColor": "rgba(99,91,255,0.3)"})`. The `transition` property must go on the base (not hover) rule so it applies in both directions.

### CODE BLOCK
- Dark pill/card `background: #0a2540` (same as hero dark), `border-radius: 12px`, horizontal padding `32px`, vertical `24px`.
- Syntax coloring: keywords in `#635bff` (indigo), strings in `#00d924` (Stripe green), comments in `#425466` (mid-gray), base text `#e3e8f0` (near-white).
- A faint top-border gradient line (`border-top: 2px solid`) transitions `#635bff → #00d4ff` left-to-right — gives it a "glowing edge" feel.
- Font: `"SF Mono", "Fira Code", monospace` at `14px / 1.6` line-height.
- **Clone recipe**: `Text` component inside a styled dark Grid. Use `fontFamily: {"value": "'SF Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace"}`, wrap color spans via nested `Text` components with individual color overrides. The glowing top-border is a `create_style` rule targeting the card's CSS class, since `border-image` (gradient border) cannot be expressed as a single `styleProperties` leaf.

### TYPOGRAPHY (hero section)
- Headline: `"Söhne"` / `"Inter"` fallback, weight 700, `~68px` desktop, `~44px` mobile, letter-spacing `-0.03em`, color `#ffffff`.
- Sub-headline: weight 400, `~22px`, color `rgba(255,255,255,0.75)`.
- CTA button: `background: #635bff`, `color: #fff`, `border-radius: 999px` (pill), `padding: 14px 28px`, hover `background: #4f46e5`.

### PALETTE SUMMARY
| Role | Hex |
|---|---|
| Hero bg dark | `#0a2540` |
| Indigo accent | `#635bff` |
| Indigo hover | `#4f46e5` |
| Cyan streak | `#00d4ff` |
| Card bg | `#ffffff` |
| Card border | `#e6ebf1` |
| Alt section bg | `#f6f9fc` |
| Body text | `#425466` |
| Hero text | `#ffffff` |

All values are already mirrored in `stripeTheme` (created during bootstrap). Page builds should reference `Theme.*` tokens rather than raw hex.
